import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 1000005;
    static int n, k, p;
    static int[] fact = new int[MAXN], inv_fact = new int[MAXN];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int mask_n = n;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            if ((n & i) == i) {
                int msk = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                    msk <<= 1;
                    if ((n & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                        if ((i & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                            msk |= 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
                mask_n = Math.max(mask_n, msk);
            }
        }

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(modPow(k, n, p));
            return;
        }

        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
            fact[i] = (int)((long)fact[i - 1] * i % p);
        }
        inv_fact[MAXN - 1] = modPow(fact[MAXN - 1], p - 2, p);
        for (int i = MAXN - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv_fact[i] = (int)((long)inv_fact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p);
        }

        int size = 1;
        while (size <= mask_n) size <<= 1;

        int[] a = new int[size];
        for (int i = 0; i <= mask_n; i++) {
            a[i] = inv_fact[i];
        }

        int res = modPow(k, n, p);
        a = subsetPower(a, k, p, size);
        int subtract_value = (int)((long)a[mask_n] * fact[n] % p);
        res = (res - subtract_value + p) % p;
        System.out.println(res);
    }

    static int modPow(int base, int exp, int mod) {
        long result = 1;
        long b = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * b) % mod;
            b = (b * b) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) result;
    }

    static int[] subsetPower(int[] a, int k, int p, int n) {
        int LOGN = 19;
        int[][] fa = new int[LOGN][n];
        int[][] fc = new int[LOGN][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < LOGN; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i) {
                    fa[i][j] = (j < a.length) ? a[j] : 0;
                } else {
                    fa[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            fftTransform(fa[i], n, p, false);
        }

        int[] res = new int[n];
        Arrays.fill(res, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int[] v = new int[LOGN];
            for (int j = 0; j < LOGN; j++) v[j] = fa[j][i];
            v = convolutionPower(v, k, p);
            for (int j = 0; j < LOGN; j++) fc[j][i] = v[j];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < LOGN; i++) {
            fftTransform(fc[i], n, p, true);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i) {
                    if (j < res.length) res[j] = fc[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void fftTransform(int[] a, int n, int p, boolean invert) {
        int logn = Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros(n) ^ 31;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = Integer.reverse(i) >>> (32 - Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(n));
            if (i < j) {
                int temp = a[i];
                a[i] = a[j];
                a[j] = temp;
            }
        }
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int wlen = invert ? modPow(3, p - 1 - (p - 1) / len, p) : modPow(3, (p - 1) / len, p);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                int w = 1;
                for (int j = 0; j < len / 2; j++) {
                    int u = a[i + j];
                    int v = (int)((long)a[i + j + len / 2] * w % p);
                    a[i + j] = u + v < p ? u + v : u + v - p;
                    a[i + j + len / 2] = u - v >= 0 ? u - v : u - v + p;
                    w = (int)((long)w * wlen % p);
                }
            }
        }
        if (invert) {
            int invN = modPow(n, p - 2, p);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                a[i] = (int)((long)a[i] * invN % p);
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] convolutionPower(int[] v, int k, int p) {
        int n = v.length;
        if (k == 1) return v;
        if (k % 2 == 1) {
            int[] prev = convolutionPower(v, k - 1, p);
            int[] result = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j + i < n; j++) {
                    long val = (long)prev[i] * v[j] + result[i + j];
                    result[i + j] = (int)(val % p);
                }
            }
            return result;
        } else {
            int[] half = convolutionPower(v, k / 2, p);
            int[] result = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j + i < n; j++) {
                    long val = (long)half[i] * half[j] + result[i + j];
                    result[i + j] = (int)(val % p);
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }
}
